name: dispatch
description: Peer-to-peer agentic task courier between two humans, run from your terminal. Sign in with `dispatch login`, then delegate a task to a trusted contact's machine — their local agent runs it across an explicit, scoped, revocable trust edge, cryptographically signed by your device and approved by them. A dispatch can use the recipient's own MCP tools, scoped per edge. Invite contacts, check your inbox, accept/decline, and track dispatches in natural language.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate a task to a trusted contact's machine — signed, scoped, and approved.
interface.longDescription: Dispatch is a courier for agentic work. You describe a task and name a recipient; their machine runs it with their own local agent. Nothing runs unless an accepted trust edge exists from you to them, the dispatch carries a valid signature from your device, and it stays inside the scope that edge grants — with destructive tool calls gated on a per-call human approval. Requires the `dispatch` CLI (pipx) and a one-time `dispatch login`.
